request.project_task: Build a university course registration portal.
request.project_goal: Let students enroll while enforcing prerequisites and capacity.
request.project_description: Students search courses, enroll or join a waitlist, and drop future courses.

functional_requirements.text: A student searches courses by term and subject.

atoms.text: A student searches courses by term and subject.

functional_requirements.text: A student enrolls in an eligible course.

atoms.text: A student enrolls in an eligible course.

functional_requirements.text: A student joins a waitlist when a course is full.

atoms.text: A student joins a waitlist when a course is full.

functional_requirements.text: A student drops a future course.

atoms.text: A student drops a future course.

non_functional_requirements.text: Enrollment updates must be serializable to prevent oversubscription.

actors.name: Student
actors.description: A university student who searches, enrolls in, waitlists for, and drops courses.

use_cases.name: Search Courses
use_cases.goal: Find courses offered in a given term and subject.
use_cases.trigger: Student initiates a course search by term and subject.

preconditions.text: The student is authenticated and has access to the registration portal.

success_postconditions.text: A list of courses matching the selected term and subject is displayed to the student.

failure_postconditions.text: No matching courses are found and the student is informed.

main_success_scenario.name: Student searches courses by term and subject

steps.action: Student selects a term and subject and submits the search.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the search criteria.

steps.action: The system retrieves courses matching the term and subject.
The system displays the matching course list to the student.
steps.expected_result: The student sees the list of matching courses.

exception_scenarios.name: No courses match the search criteria

steps.action: The system finds no courses matching the term and subject.
The system informs the student that no courses match the search criteria.
steps.expected_result: The student is notified that no courses were found.

user_stories.capability: search courses by term and subject
user_stories.benefit: I can find courses I am interested in enrolling in

system_stories.system_action: Retrieve and display courses matching the selected term and subject.
system_stories.responsibility: Provide accurate course search results based on term and subject.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-001 — Search Courses
Goal: Find courses offered in a given term and subject.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student initiates a course search by term and subject.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC001-001: The student is authenticated and has access to the registration portal.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC001-001] Student selects a term and subject and submits the search.
  2. [STEP-UC001-002] The system retrieves courses matching the term and subject.
  3. [STEP-UC001-003] The system displays the matching course list to the student.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC001-EXC-001: No courses match the search criteria
Source FRs: FR-001

use_cases.name: Enroll in Course
use_cases.goal: Enroll in an eligible course after prerequisite and capacity checks.
use_cases.trigger: Student selects a course and requests enrollment.

preconditions.text: The student is authenticated and has access to the registration portal.
The student has selected a course for enrollment.

success_postconditions.text: The student is enrolled in the selected course.

failure_postconditions.text: The student is not enrolled because prerequisites are not met.
The student is not enrolled because the course is full.

main_success_scenario.name: Student enrolls in an eligible course

steps.action: Student requests enrollment in the selected course.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the enrollment request.

steps.action: The system checks the course prerequisites.
The system checks the remaining capacity.
The system enrolls the student in the course.
steps.expected_result: The student is enrolled and the enrollment is recorded.

steps.action: The system determines that the student does not meet the course prerequisites.
The system informs the student that prerequisites are not met and does not enroll the student.
steps.expected_result: The student is notified and remains not enrolled.

steps.action: The system determines that the course has no remaining capacity.
The system informs the student that the course is full and does not enroll the student.
steps.expected_result: The student is notified and remains not enrolled.

user_stories.benefit: I can secure a place in a course I am qualified for

system_stories.system_action: Check prerequisites and remaining capacity, then enroll the student if eligible.
system_stories.responsibility: Enforce prerequisite and capacity rules during enrollment.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-002 — Enroll in Course
Goal: Enroll in an eligible course after prerequisite and capacity checks.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student selects a course and requests enrollment.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC002-001: The student is authenticated and has access to the registration portal.
  - PRE-UC002-002: The student has selected a course for enrollment.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC002-001] Student requests enrollment in the selected course.
  2. [STEP-UC002-002] The system checks the course prerequisites.
  3. [STEP-UC002-003] The system checks the remaining capacity.
  4. [STEP-UC002-004] The system enrolls the student in the course.
Exception scenarios:
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-001: Prerequisites not met
  - SCN-UC002-EXC-002: Course is full
Source FRs: FR-002, FR-003, FR-004

use_cases.name: Join Waitlist
use_cases.goal: Join the waitlist for a full course.
use_cases.trigger: Student requests to join the waitlist for a full course.

preconditions.text: The student is authenticated and has access to the registration portal.
The student has selected a course that is full.

success_postconditions.text: The student is added to the waitlist for the selected course.

failure_postconditions.text: The student is not added to the waitlist.

main_success_scenario.name: Student joins waitlist for a full course

steps.action: Student requests to join the waitlist for the full course.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the waitlist request.

steps.action: The system adds the student to the waitlist for the course.
steps.expected_result: The student is placed on the waitlist.

user_stories.capability: join a waitlist when a course is full
user_stories.benefit: I can have a chance to enroll if a spot becomes available

system_stories.system_action: Add the student to the waitlist for the full course.
system_stories.responsibility: Maintain an ordered waitlist for full courses.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-003 — Join Waitlist
Goal: Join the waitlist for a full course.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student requests to join the waitlist for a full course.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC003-001: The student is authenticated and has access to the registration portal.
  - PRE-UC003-002: The student has selected a course that is full.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC003-001] Student requests to join the waitlist for the full course.
  2. [STEP-UC003-002] The system adds the student to the waitlist for the course.
Source FRs: FR-005

use_cases.name: Drop Course
use_cases.trigger: Student requests to drop a future course.

preconditions.text: The student is authenticated and has access to the registration portal.
The student is enrolled in a future course.

success_postconditions.text: The student is dropped from the future course.

failure_postconditions.text: The student remains enrolled in the course.

steps.action: Student requests to drop a future course.
steps.expected_result: The system receives the drop request.

steps.action: The system drops the student from the future course.
steps.expected_result: The student is no longer enrolled in the course.

user_stories.benefit: I can adjust my schedule before the course starts

system_stories.system_action: Remove the student's enrollment from the future course.
system_stories.responsibility: Process drop requests for future courses.

use_cases.human_readable_text:
Use Case: UC-004 — Drop Course
Goal: Drop a future course enrollment.
Primary actor: ACT-001
Trigger: Student requests to drop a future course.
Preconditions:
  - PRE-UC004-001: The student is authenticated and has access to the registration portal.
  - PRE-UC004-002: The student is enrolled in a future course.
Main success scenario:
  1. [STEP-UC004-001] Student requests to drop a future course.
  2. [STEP-UC004-002] The system drops the student from the future course.
Source FRs: FR-006
